newsitem.title: TAIWAN: FORECAST-Taiwan March export orders - Reuters poll.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Taiwan March export orders - Reuters poll.

text.p: A Reuters poll of Taiwan economists projected slow year-on-year growth of 1.95 percent for Taiwan's export orders in March due to a weak first quarter export performance.
The figures are due to be released by the economics ministry at around 0230 GMT on April 22.
February's export orders fell 1.70 percent year-on-year.
"I believe export orders will not show an apparent recovery until May when the electronics industry starts its booming growth," said Core Pacific Securities economist J.C. Yang.

"As the international economy still sees slow recovery, demand for Taiwan goods were still weak in March," said HSBC James Capel economist Stephen Wang. "Even China, which cut interest rates last year, did not show stronger demand."
